Bug_Title: Assertions should not compare an object to itself
Bug_Explanation: The Assert.assertEquals method is used to test the equality of two objects. In this case, the same object is being compared to itself. This is a common bug because it is easy to miss when writing tests. This can lead to false positives and false negatives in the test results.
